subject.title: [Feature]: Async voice notes in the mobile chat composer (record and send as audio attachment)

question: Should OpenClaw first-party mobile apps add scoped async voice-note recording in the chat composer now, using the existing attachment and media-understanding server path?
rationale: The backend path exists, but the user-facing recorder, mic ownership, offline behavior, and platform UX are product decisions already represented by open iOS and Android PRs.

options.title: Approve scoped mobile v1
options.body: Proceed with bounded iOS and Android composer record-and-send implementations that reuse chat.send attachments and preserve current online-only attachment behavior.

options.title: Prototype one platform first
options.body: Land or validate one platform before committing to both, reducing UX and mic-coordination risk at the cost of cross-platform parity.

options.title: Defer voice notes
options.body: Keep Talk mode and third-party channels as the voice path for now and close or pause the linked mobile PRs.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped mobile v1
recommendation.body: Proceed with bounded iOS and Android composer record-and-send implementations that reuse chat.send attachments and preserve current online-only attachment behavior.
